autoSpawn.note: DISABLED 2026-07-03 (session 5) after the true auto-spawn hop FAILED to produce a working successor. Evidence: two independent create_new_session_on_fire triggers — the enabled-run trig_01VeDUPhfYLEz41fgMw8vEGa, and a clean minimal probe trig_01DJ5H5Rko2QkAX2QaTt7KNR whose prompt explicitly fetch+checkouts the branch — both reported ended_reason=run_once_fired but neither produced a visible session OR pushed any commit within 10+ min. Per the Claude Code web docs, run_once_fired/green means only 'the schedule fired and the session exited without an INFRASTRUCTURE error' — NOT that the successor did work — and there is no observable success signal to gate on. Root cause is NOT our code: guard/consumer/hooks worked (a valid trigger was created + fired); the failure is downstream platform session-provisioning we cannot verify or observe. Auto-spawn is OFF; the program uses the MANUAL-continuation fallback (see docs/blueprints/session-automation-auto-handoff.md 'Auto-spawn failure (2026-07-03)'). The prompt-checkout FIX (successor must git fetch+checkout the working branch — spawns boot on main) is kept in auto-spawn-fire.mjs + auto-handoff.mjs for if/when the platform hop is verified. Cap counter reset (the earlier consecutiveCount=1 was for a spawn that never ran). TEMPLATE DEFAULT was already false; this program is now false too.
